issue.title: test_family_container_badge_does_not_alter_status_chip fails on master: format_agent_option lost its parallel_family_counts kwarg
issue.description:
tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_list_monitor_rows.py::test_family_container_badge_does_not_alter_status_chip fails deterministically on clean master 2605324cb.

REPRODUCTION (workspace sase_14, after a from-scratch 'just install', no local changes to the files involved):
  .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_list_monitor_rows.py::test_family_container_badge_does_not_alter_status_chip -q -p no:randomly
  -> 1 failed

FAILURE:
  TypeError: format_agent_option() got an unexpected keyword argument 'parallel_family_counts'
  at tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_list_monitor_rows.py:331

ROOT CAUSE: commit 49be5b0d3 'fix(tui): count agent family containers as one node' (SASE_PLAN=202608/agent_node_status_counts.md, a tale plan with no bead, so no epic owns it) removed the 'parallel_family_counts' keyword-only parameter from format_agent_option in src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/_agent_list_render_agent.py:136. The parameter had been added by 45c04ae99 'feat(ace): compact parallel family status counts'. 49be5b0d3 updated its own tests but left this pre-existing caller, which still passes parallel_family_counts=ParallelFamilyStatusCounts(running=2, awaiting=1) to assert that a family-container badge does not alter the status chip.

SCOPE: decide which side is correct and make them agree. Either the container-badge/status-chip behavior this test guards is still a real requirement — in which case restore a supported way to express it against the current signature — or 49be5b0d3 intentionally retired that path, in which case delete or rewrite the test against the new API. Do not simply delete the assertion to get green: it is the only coverage that a parallel-family count badge does not leak into the status chip. Verify with the surrounding tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_list_monitor_rows.py module and 'just check'.

DISCOVERED BY: sase-n8.land during epic sase-n8 landing verification. 'just test-scoped' reported 2 failed / 31684 passed / 11 skipped in 341s; this was one of the two, and neither is related to sase-n8's diff (Launch Control footer markup plus one Justfile symvision entry). The other is already tracked as sase-nt.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-kp — closed phase sase-kp.7 ('Monitor rows in agent lists and family rosters') authored tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_list_monitor_rows.py, so that epic owns the intent behind the assertion even though it did not cause the break. Worth reading sase-kp.7 before deciding whether the container-badge/status-chip separation is still a requirement.

RELATED: sase-nt — the other deterministic master failure surfaced by the same 'just test-scoped' run during sase-n8 landing; different root cause (model_alias_defaults.yml pool membership), same class of defect (a commit updated its own tests but missed a pre-existing caller).
